facts.claim: Kemenko PMK (Indonesian Coordinating Ministry for Human Development and Culture), press release of 16 September 2026: the Government set 18 national public holidays and 8 collective leave (cuti bersama) days for 2027 under the SKB of the Minister of Religious Affairs, Minister of Manpower and Minister of State Apparatus Empowerment and Bureaucratic Reform (No. 1205/2026, No. 3/2026, No. 2/2026). Hari Suci Nyepi (Tahun Baru Saka 1949) is listed on 8 March 2027 (Monday).

Kemenko PMK 2027 national holidays as listed: 1 Jan New Year; 5 Jan Isra Mikraj 1448 H; 6 Feb Chinese New Year 2578; 8 Mar Nyepi; 10 to 11 Mar Idul Fitri 1448 H; 26 Mar Good Friday; 28 Mar Easter Sunday; 1 May Labour Day; 6 May Ascension Day; 17 May Idul Adha 1448 H; 20 May Waisak 2571 BE; 1 Jun Pancasila Day; 6 Jun Islamic New Year 1449 H; 15 Aug Maulid Nabi; 17 Aug Independence Day; 25 Dec Christmas; 26 Dec Isra Mikraj 1449 H. The release notes the 1 Ramadan, Idul Fitri and Idul Adha dates are set by a separate Minister of Religious Affairs decision (per the SKB PDF snippet).
facts.conflicts: Search snippet of the SKB PDF says Idul Fitri and Idul Adha dates are confirmed by a later ministerial decision, so these two dates may shift.

facts.claim: Kemenko PMK 2027 collective leave (cuti bersama): 5 Feb (Chinese New Year); 9, 12 and 15 Mar (Idul Fitri); 25 Mar (Good Friday); 18 May (Idul Adha); 19 May (Waisak); 24 Dec (Christmas). Cuti bersama applies to civil servants (ASN) and is optional for private employers. Nyepi on 8 Mar sits beside the Idul Fitri holidays and leave (9 to 15 Mar).

Heavy rains can cause significant flooding in urban areas including Bali, disrupting roads and transport. No temperature or rainfall figures are given.

Indonesia uses a 4-level volcano alert system (Normal, Advisory, Watch, Warning). Contact your airline for the latest flight information.

insider_details.detail: Nyepi falls on Monday 8 March 2027, right before the Idul Fitri holidays and collective leave (9 to 15 March), so avoid that fortnight for a wedding weekend and book flights early if guests travel then.

Smartraveller puts Bali's wet season at around October to April with fast-changing weather and urban flooding, so a wet-season date needs a covered or indoor ceremony back-up and generous transfer buffers.

Glass and clifftop chapels (AYANA Tresna, Mulia, Apurva Kempinski Kimaya, St. Regis Cloud Nine) keep the ocean view under cover, but published seating is small, so confirm capacity before treating one as the rain plan.
Volcanic ash can close airports with little notice, so build a spare day before the wedding into guest travel advice.
